When an accident granted Jade the power to hear thoughts, she was forced to confront the truth about others—and herself—in this twisty paranormal mystery.

San Diego, CA, USA – WEBWIRE – Tuesday, October 27, 2026

When Jade gains the power to hear thoughts, she discovers that knowing the truth isn’t always what she hoped for.

For avid readers of paranormal fiction, a treat awaited them at the 2026 Frankfurt Book Fair. “I Heard That” by Loretta Gorrell was displayed by the self-publishing and book marketing company ReadersMagnet at the renowned book trade fair at Messe Frankfurt, Frankfurt, Germany, from October 7 to 11, 2026.

In “I Heard That,” readers meet Jade, a young woman whose life took a turn after she went through a terrible situation when two men try to kidnap her. As she recovered in the hospital with a bump on her head, it became clear to her that the accident had given her a special ability - she could hear other people’s thoughts without their knowledge.

What initially seemed to Jade like an opportunity to learn interesting things about other people became unexpected and, at times, unpleasant and even painful. In particular, one shocking thing that she learns is the fact that the person who rescued her from those two men treats her as a bimbo with blond hair and is very self-centered.

In this story, the author used Jade’s experience to show how looking beneath the surface could shape how people saw themselves and others. For Jade, her supernatural power became more than a bizarre result of a physical injury; instead, it gave her a chance to discover what truly mattered.

The Frankfurt Book Fair provides an ideal global platform for Loretta Gorrell’s book. Celebrated as the Frankfurter Buchmesse, this renowned literary event brings together authors, publishers, readers, and industry professionals from around the world.

Through this vibrant gathering, Gorrell’s story invited readers everywhere to explore how the extraordinary could illuminate what truly mattered in everyday life. Visitors had the opportunity to view the book display at the ReadersMagnet exhibit space at Stand 4.1 M5.

Author’s Biography:

Loretta Gorrell is an author whose journey from a shy childhood in Sunset Hills, Missouri, to a thriving writing career is marked by resilience and warmth. The youngest of six children, Loretta grew up surrounded by a close-knit family and community.

Her early struggles in school left her feeling underestimated, but she later proved her abilities by building and running a successful daycare with eight employees and more than a hundred children.

After selling her business, Loretta turned to her passion for storytelling, crafting novels that blend suspense, romance, and humor. Now settled on a farm in Redbird, Missouri, with her husband, she enjoys the company of her grandchildren, draft horses, Great Danes, and cattle. Loretta’s life experiences and love of family shine through in her engaging, heartfelt stories.
